title: At the swimming pool reception
instructions: Bir öğrenci yüzme havuzu hakkında bilgi alıyor. Saatler ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hi. What time does the pool open?

script.speaker: b
script.text: At seven in the morning. It closes at ten at night.

script.speaker: a
script.text: How much is it for students?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Three pounds. For adults, it's five.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Do I need a swimming cap?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, you do. We sell them here for two pounds.
